product: Advantage Plus ELITE Hospital Indemnity Insurance
tagline: Cash paid directly to the insured for hospital stays and related events - supplements a Medicare Advantage plan or any primary health coverage.
policy_type: Limited benefit health insurance (NOT a Medicare Supplement, NOT a substitute for major medical). Guaranteed renewable for life as long as premiums are paid on time.
key_selling_points: Base benefits kick in after 6 hours (Short Duration Hospital Stay benefit covers 6-24hr stays)
No hospital stay required for Emergency Room benefit ($150, injury or accident)
Rates don't increase as the client ages - locked at issue age
Simplified underwriting with instant approval in most cases
Guaranteed Issue for ages 64.5 up to 80 (NJ, UT excluded; UT excluded 64.5-70) - no medical questions required in that window except for the Cancer rider
Unlimited benefit restoration after 60 days with no hospital confinement
No limits to lifetime benefits received
Benefits paid directly to the insured (or assigned designee) - usable for any purpose, not just medical bills

example_talk_track_scenario.premise: Client has a Medicare Advantage plan with a $300/day inpatient hospital co-pay for days 1-6.
example_talk_track_scenario.event: 6-day inpatient hospital stay -> $1,800 out-of-pocket co-pay ($300 x 6 days).
example_talk_track_scenario.gtl_solution: GTL hospital indemnity pays a $300/day cash benefit for each day hospitalized (up to plan max) -> $1,800 cash received, usable to cover the Medicare Advantage co-pay.
example_talk_track_scenario.sample_premium_reference: ~$25/month at age 65 for a comparable daily benefit (illustrative only - always quote from the actual rate table for the client's state/age/benefit selection).
example_talk_track_scenario.closing_point: Because benefits restore after 60 days with no confinement, this isn't a one-time-use policy - it's there again if it's needed again.

general_policy_exclusions: Treatment/services not deemed Medically Necessary, Experimental, received without charge or legal obligation to pay, received from an immediate family member, or received outside the United States
Injury/sickness caused or aggravated by intentionally self-inflicted injury, suicide, or attempted suicide (sane or insane)
Injury/sickness from war or active military service
Injury/sickness from participating in, committing, or attempting an assault, felony, riot, or civil commotion
Injury/sickness arising from employment and covered/payable under workers' compensation or occupational disease law
Cosmetic or elective surgery (except reconstructive surgery incidental to covered trauma/sickness/injury, or for a congenital anomaly)
Injury/sickness from operating a vehicle while under the influence of a controlled substance or while intoxicated
Confinement/treatment due to alcohol or voluntary use of drugs/narcotics/controlled substances not prescribed by a doctor
Losses incurred before the policy effective date or after termination/expiration
not_a_substitute_disclosure: THIS IS A SUPPLEMENT TO HEALTH INSURANCE AND IS NOT A SUBSTITUTE FOR MAJOR MEDICAL COVERAGE. LACK OF MAJOR MEDICAL COVERAGE (OR OTHER MINIMUM ESSENTIAL COVERAGE) MAY RESULT IN AN ADDITIONAL PAYMENT WITH YOUR TAXES.
